sloka: विभीषण त्वया वत्स धर्मसंहितबुद्धिना ।परितुष्टो ऽस्मि धर्मात्मन्वरं वरय सुव्रत ।। ७.१०.२८ ॥
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇa tvayā vatsa dharmasaṁhitabuddhinā ।parituṣṭo 'smi dharmātmanvaraṁ varaya suvrata ।। 7.10.28 ॥

translations.english: O Vibhishana, O dear child, I am greatly pleased by you, O righteous-souled one, whose intellect is aligned with dharma; therefore, O virtuous one, choose a boon.
